//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the DEFINITION-LIST CONTAINER — the `.pa-list-definition` block, applied to a <dl> (keen `PureAdmin.Components.List.definition_list/1`, svelte `display/DefinitionList.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. The harness renders one component whose slot receives plain TEXT (the dumper HTML-escapes it), so the dt/dd term/description pairs can't flow through the slot; the body area is a bare text token. The dt/dd pairs are NATIVE HTML elements the consumer writes by hand inside the slot (snippets/lists.html L134-155) — pure-admin styles them via element selectors (`.pa-list-definition dt` / ` dd`), NOT via any __element classes, so there are literally no pa-list-definition__* classes to cover (grep '\.pa-list-definition__' on main.css is empty). This fixture proves ONLY what the container itself emits: its <dl> tag, its pa-list-definition class, the single --inline modifier, and the class passthrough.

propsVocabulary.inline: boolean — inline (horizontal) key-value layout (pa-list-definition--inline): dt/dd on one line, dt gets a ': ' suffix via ::after, each dd ends in a block-level line break so pairs stack. svelte: isInline (bool); keen: is_inline (bool)
propsVocabulary.body: the dt/dd pair area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real <dt>/<dd> children are native elements written inside the slot by the consumer, not a sub-component)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only — the definition-list container adds no attribute conventions (unlike button's type). The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the container's tag (<dl>) + class + the single --inline modifier, not rich dt/dd content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. axis-1 reverse-check is scoped to the pa-list-definition--* BLOCK modifiers; the ONLY one that exists is --inline (produced by the feature below). There are NO pa-list-definition__* element classes — the dt/dd pairs are styled via native element selectors (`.pa-list-definition dt` / ` dd`), authored by hand inside the slot, so nothing is deferred here (unlike list/banded, which have real __element sub-components). body + extraClass are structural/passthrough.

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; dt/dd pairs are native elements written inside the slot by the consumer

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature
